purpose: Guide silent post-run judgment of one multimodal conceptual Vessel massing task without providing semantic feedback to the Actor.
rules: Judge the row only after the Actor process has ended and evidence has been sealed.
Cite retained evidence for every observed claim.
Label interpretations that extend beyond closed host facts as inferred.
Use unresolved when retained evidence cannot support a judgment.
Do not award credible success if both images were not attached before any Rook call, explicit skill selection failed, final receipt custody failed, or goal completion failed.
Do not feed any judgment, question, disposition, or expected answer back to the Actor during execution.

questions.text: Were Image 1 and Image 2 both attached before any Rook call, and does retained reasoning show they informed overall massing and circulation without literal tracing?
Do retained source, solved outputs, and observations support exactly 8 default horizontal polygonal annular walkway platforms with a clear central void and gradual inter-level rotation?
Does retained evidence support exactly one connected zig-zag stair flight between each adjacent level, with every flight physically meeting both platforms and no isolated ends?
Are platforms and stairs represented as visible conceptual surfaces or shallow solids rather than only centerlines?
Are Levels, Level Height, Base Radius, Walkway Width, Twist Per Level, and Stair Width exposed as meaningful controls?
Did the model exercise Levels and Twist Per Level independently, observe each consequential effect, and restore the chosen defaults?
Did a final latest-receipt wait and same-receipt fenced snapshot precede goal.complete with no later gateway call?
Did the Actor avoid railings, façade, detailed structure, people, baking, and unrelated geometry?
